story.iWant: the app to automatically adjust audio parameters when I accept a suggestion or enable auto-adjust
story.soThat: the audio experience adapts to my physiological state without requiring manual intervention

criterion.title: Auto-Adjust Preset Application
criterion.given: user accepts a sensor suggestion OR enables "Auto-adjust" toggle
criterion.when: SensorRuleEngine determines preset change is needed
criterion.then: - Apply preset parameters via existing applyPreset() helper - Parameters affected: intensity, noiseVolume, binauralFreq - Changes apply with less-than-20ms latency (matching PRD audio control requirement) - Console log: [SensorRuleEngine] Auto-applying preset: {presetId}
criterion.technicalNotes: Reuse applyPreset() from PresetProvider (Epic 3). Must not create new audio graph nodes; only modify parameters.

criterion.title: Lock Icon Visibility
criterion.then: - Lock icon appears next to affected sliders (intensity, noise, binaural) - Lock icon has tooltip: "Sensor automation active. Click to pause." - Lock icon has ARIA label: "Sensor automation active, click to take manual control" - Icon animates briefly (pulse) when automation makes a change
criterion.integrationPoint: Epic 3 Story 3-2 already implemented sensorLocked state and lock icon placeholder. This story wires the icon to actual sensor automation state.

criterion.title: Manual Control Override (Lock Icon Click)
criterion.then: - Set sensorLocked = false in PresetProvider - Lock icon changes to unlocked with tooltip "Automation paused" - Log event: { type: "AUTOMATION_PAUSED", trigger: "lock_icon" } - User retains manual control until they re-enable auto-adjust - Toast shown: "Sensor automation paused. Toggle Auto-adjust to resume."

criterion.title: Slider Interaction Override
criterion.when: user manually adjusts any slider (intensity, noise, binaural, etc.)
criterion.then: - Immediately pause sensor automation (sensorLocked = false) - Log event: { type: "AUTOMATION_PAUSED", trigger: "manual_slider", slider: "{sliderName}" } - Unlock icon shown - User's manual value takes precedence - Toast shown: "Manual adjustment detected. Sensor automation paused."

criterion.title: Auto-Adjust Settings Toggle
criterion.then: - "Auto-adjust" toggle visible when sensor is connected - Toggle default: OFF (user must opt-in) - Persist to localStorage: mp3_8d_auto_adjust_enabled - When toggled ON: Set sensorLocked = true, enable rule engine automation - When toggled OFF: Set sensorLocked = false, rule engine only shows suggestions - Helper text: "When enabled, app automatically adjusts audio based on heart rate"

criterion.title: Session Event Logging
criterion.when: any automation event occurs (applies preset, user pauses, toggle changes)

criterion.title: Performance Requirement
criterion.given: sensor automation is active and rule engine triggers a change
criterion.then: - Change applies in less-than-20ms from rule trigger to audio parameter update - Use performance.mark() and performance.measure() to validate - Log measurement to console in debug mode: [SensorRuleEngine] Preset applied in {X}ms

doc.title: Architecture - mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: SensorRuleEngine monitors data stream, triggering recommendations when thresholds exceed user-defined ranges. Emits SENSOR_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED event consumed by presets + UI to show suggestions.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sensor and Adaptive Loop
doc.snippet: 1. User accepts suggestion OR enables "Auto-adjust" toggle. 2. sensorLocked state set to true in PresetProvider. 3. Lock icon appears on Advanced Controls drawer. 4. SensorRuleEngine applies preset changes via applyPreset(). 5. User can click lock icon, manually adjust slider, or toggle off to pause automation.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sensor and Adaptive Loop
doc.snippet: AC5.3.1-7: Sensor signals auto-adjust intensity/noise/binaural parameters, lock icon shows automation active, clicking lock pauses automation, slider adjustment auto-pauses, auto-adjust toggle enables/disables, all events logged, changes apply in less-than-20ms.

doc.title: Epics and Stories - mp3_to_8D
doc.snippet: S5.3: Sensor signals can auto-adjust intensity/noise/binaural parameters while a lock icon indicates automation; users can pause automation or lock preset; overrides recorded.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Audio parameter changes apply in less than 20ms - sensor-driven preset changes must match this target.

doc.title: Story 5.2: Heart Rate Subscription and Threshold Engine
doc.snippet: SensorRuleEngine created at index.html:10267-10323. logSensorEvent() helper at index.html:10205-10226. Suggestion toast at index.html:6229-6308. 24 tests in tests/heart-rate-engine.test.js.

doc.title: Story 5.1: Capability Detection and Consent UI
doc.snippet: SensorProvider pattern with capability detection implemented. useSensorBridge hook exposes connection/disconnection APIs. Toast notification patterns established.

doc.title: Data Models
doc.snippet: Session includes sensorEvents[] array for logging sensor-related events with timestamp, type, and contextual data.

artifact.reason: Core rule engine that evaluates HR thresholds. Extend with auto-apply mode for this story.
Event logging helper to extend with new event types: AUTOMATION_APPLIED, AUTOMATION_PAUSED, AUTO_ADJUST_ENABLED, AUTO_ADJUST_DISABLED.
Existing toast component for preset suggestions. Reuse toast patterns for automation notifications.
Contains sliders and lock icon placeholder. Wire lock icon visibility to sensorLocked state and add slider override detection.
Existing preset application function with performance.mark() instrumentation. Call from rule engine in auto-apply mode.
State variable controlling automation mode. Already implemented in Epic 3 Story 3-2. Wire to auto-adjust toggle.
HR threshold persisted to localStorage (mp3_8d_hr_threshold). Follow same pattern for auto-adjust toggle.
Sensor simulator for testing. Use to test auto-adjust functionality without physical sensor.
24 existing tests for HR parsing, buffer, rule engine. Follow structure for new auto-adjust tests.

constraints.constraint: All implementation in index.html (maintaining single-file architecture per project convention)
Must not create new audio graph nodes; only modify parameters via applyPreset()
Preset application latency must be less than 20ms (PRD requirement)
Rule evaluation must complete in less than 50ms per tick
sensorLocked state already exists in PresetProvider from Epic 3 Story 3-2 - reuse it
Use localStorage key mp3_8d_auto_adjust_enabled for toggle persistence (follow mp3_8d_hr_threshold pattern)
Lock icon must have ARIA label and tooltip for screen reader support
User opt-in required - auto-adjust toggle defaults to OFF
All automation events must be logged to sensorEvents[] array via logSensorEvent()

interface.name: applyPreset
interface.notes: Already includes performance.mark() instrumentation. Batch updates all audio parameters.

interface.name: logSensorEvent
interface.notes: Extend with new event types for automation. Data includes hr, hrAvg, threshold, and contextual fields.

interface.name: setSensorLocked
interface.notes: Controls automation state. When true, sliders are disabled and lock icon shows.

interface.name: setA11yAnnouncement
interface.notes: Announce automation state changes to screen readers.

interface.name: MODE_LIBRARY
interface.notes: Contains preset definitions including 'calm' preset used for threshold-triggered automation.

tests.standards: Testing follows patterns established in Epic 5 stories. Unit tests written in Node.js with fake-indexeddb for IndexedDB mocking. Tests focus on: localStorage persistence of auto-adjust toggle, SensorRuleEngine auto-apply mode logic, event logging coverage. Integration tests verify full flow from toggle enable through threshold trigger to preset application and event logging.
